scenario: Use supplied synthetic candidate conversation content to produce inspectable evidence, proposed temporal state, one safe recruiter-owned question or no_action, and a truthful proposal-only handoff.

review_plan.reason: The plugin must produce one operationally useful recruiter-owned next step or no_action.
The plugin handles sensitive conversation evidence, identity, ambiguity, and action boundaries.
The plugin must block candidate assessment and the synthetic evaluator needs validity limits.

findings.observation: The frozen analyzer is executable and the Skill gives a stdin-only path, but the plugin was intentionally not installed, so a recruiter-facing Codex invocation was not observed.
findings.user_impact: The deterministic packet can be useful while the actual effort to supply content and inspect the result in Codex remains unknown.
findings.recommendation: After integration installs the frozen plugin, run one blind recruiter-style invocation and record steps, correction burden, and whether the Skill returns the analyzer packet unchanged.
findings.verification: A fresh installed-plugin task completes TS-CORE-01 from supplied content, preserves all four evidence spans, and returns one prepare_question proposal without manual schema repair.

findings.observation: The deterministic analyzer recognizes the frozen English phrase patterns and safely stops on unrecognized content; broader recruiter phrasing has not been tested.
findings.evidence: commit 3a90594; plugins/talent-signal/skills/analyze-candidate-signal/scripts/analyze_conversation.py sha256 01677116851f28ba7e1e592551cad2b658d8ccc53aa1034665bcef31c35c6ca1; fixture-results.json reports 8/8 frozen cases plus 3/3 supplemental boundary probes
findings.user_impact: A recruiter may receive a truthful no_action or clarification for a relevant signal phrased outside the current rules, limiting usefulness without creating an unsafe effect.
findings.recommendation: Measure abstention and missed-signal rates on an independently authored, synthetic paraphrase set before expanding the extraction rules.
findings.verification: A versioned paraphrase set reports per-field recall and critical-error rate while every unsupported phrase remains proposal-only or abstains.

strengths: All eight frozen cases produce the expected disposition, evidence-backed proposed state, and one action proposal or no_action.
TS-CORE-02 treats no_action as a successful result and creates no follow-up work.
The action artifact is specific, recruiter-owned, time-bounded, and explicitly has no execution authority.
missing_evidence: No installed Codex plugin invocation or recruiter observation.
No interruption, return-after-a-day, or correction-burden evidence.
No field evidence that this reduces work compared with the recruiter's manual fallback.
open_questions: Will Codex reliably pass supplied content over stdin and return the analyzer JSON unchanged after installation?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: The plugin performs no network or external write and instructs stdin-only handling, but the installed Codex host's retention, deletion, and derived-artifact behavior was not exercised.
findings.evidence: commit 3a90594; plugin manifest declares only supplied-content read and proposal-artifact capabilities; local-plugin-validation.json reports no MCP, app, hook, connector, or write component
findings.user_impact: A user can understand the plugin boundary while still lacking proof of how the surrounding host retains or deletes conversation content and generated packets.
findings.recommendation: At integration, document and test the host-level retention and deletion path for one synthetic task before allowing real candidate content.
findings.verification: Create and delete a synthetic installed-plugin task; verify the documented host surfaces and registered derivatives no longer expose the source or packet.

findings.observation: The analyzer requires an authorization kind and purpose, but that declaration is supplied by its caller rather than independently attested by a connector or policy service.
findings.evidence: commit 3a90594; fixture-results.json supplemental check missing_authorization_is_rejected passes; analyze_conversation.py accepts only synthetic or user_authorized declarations and has no retrieval capability
findings.user_impact: The narrow local capability cannot widen access itself, but an invoking agent could mislabel already-available content if the surrounding task boundary is not enforced.
findings.recommendation: Keep retrieval absent and have the installed Skill state the current user-supplied source and purpose in the visible handoff.
findings.verification: A blind installed-plugin test with no supplied conversation refuses analysis; a supplied synthetic test visibly reports authorization and purpose in source.

strengths: Every material state proposal cites an exact source substring, message ID, speaker, capture time, timezone, and confirmation requirement.
Same-name, missing-identity, unknown-speaker, and ambiguous-time paths stop before state or action.
The only action type is recruiter-owned prepare_question with execution_authority none, and every handoff reports confirmed_state_changed false and external_effect not_attempted.
TS-BOUND-01 blocks candidate assessment and returns no state or action.
missing_evidence: No installed-host retention, export, or deletion test.
No OCR, screenshot layout, speaker-side inversion, or recognition-confidence evidence; those inputs are outside this plugin slice.
No real candidate data, multi-tenant retrieval, external permission, retry, reconciliation, or destination result was tested because the plugin exposes none of those capabilities.
open_questions: Which Codex host retention and deletion guarantees will apply when integration installs the frozen plugin?

reviews.lens: validity, reliability, fairness, and evaluation design

findings.observation: The frozen suite contains 8 synthetic English cases and the deterministic analyzer was implemented against that declared contract; there is no independently authored held-out or paraphrase set.
findings.evidence: evals/candidate-momentum-v1.json version 2026-08-05.1 sha256 b776e991861512b0de41a2c130a5f446e0f9f4aa418b26dd948d1f9468274b94; fixture-results.json reports 8/8 with exact per-case packets
findings.user_impact: The result proves contract conformance on these cases, not general extraction accuracy, language coverage, fairness, or recruiter value.
findings.recommendation: Create an independently authored, versioned held-out synthetic set stratified by field, paraphrase, ambiguity, speaker, identity, no_action, and prohibited assessment.
findings.verification: Report assertion precision and recall, identity and speaker critical-error rate, abstention coverage, and selection-boundary false-pass rate with numerator and denominator on the untouched set.

findings.observation: Contract checks are deterministic and evidence-citing, but the installed Skill's model invocation was not run and no independent human gold adjudication was collected.
findings.evidence: commit 3a90594; run manifest scope intentionally excludes installation; fixture-results.json contract_claim limits proof to deterministic fixture behavior
findings.user_impact: The implementation cannot yet claim that an invoking model will preserve the packet unchanged or follow the same abstention boundary.
findings.recommendation: After installation, blind a fresh model run to expected outputs and human-adjudicate all boundary cases plus a stratified sample of ordinary cases.
findings.verification: The installed Skill has zero false passes on TS-ID-01, TS-ACT-01, and TS-BOUND-01 and exact evidence agreement on TS-CORE-01; repeat once with stable results.

strengths: The evaluation unit is atomic: disposition, assertion field/status/value, exact evidence span, action semantics, and truthful outcome are checked separately.
The suite includes no_action, identity ambiguity, forwarded speech, availability-without-consent, temporal ambiguity, supersession, and a polished prohibited-assessment request.
TS-BOUND-01 returns block with no candidate score, ranking, proxy, state, or action.
The result reports 8/8 frozen cases and 3/3 supplemental boundary probes without a composite candidate or product score.
missing_evidence: No held-out set, human gold labels, language slices, or paraphrase coverage.
No installed model run, repeat-stability test, or independent adjudication.
No claim or evidence for candidate-job fit, performance, potential, personality, or acceptance prediction; those constructs remain prohibited.
open_questions: What installed-model and prompt versions will integration freeze for forward testing?

top_findings.reason: The real bundled analyzer passed directly, but the intentionally uninstalled Skill-to-analyzer handoff remains unobserved.
top_findings.next_step: Install the frozen commit in integration and run one blind TS-CORE-01 task.
top_findings.verification: The installed Skill returns the exact proposal layers and never alters state or attempts an effect.

top_findings.reason: Plugin-local code has no retrieval or write path, but host retention and deletion are not proven.
top_findings.next_step: Run a synthetic host retention and deletion test before real candidate content is allowed.
top_findings.verification: The documented source and generated derivatives are absent from user-visible host surfaces after deletion.

top_findings.reason: Eight frozen fixtures prove only declared contract conformance and do not establish general extraction behavior.
top_findings.next_step: Create an independently authored synthetic held-out paraphrase and boundary set.
top_findings.verification: Report atomic error and abstention measures with zero false passes on identity, consent, and candidate-assessment gates.

agreements: All reviewers accept that the frozen deterministic surface preserves proposal-only state, no_action, and no-execution boundaries on the declared cases.
All reviewers limit the result to synthetic fixture conformance and reject claims about field value, production privacy, OCR, or model generalization.
No reviewer identified an active veto in the frozen repository-local plugin.
adjudication.rationale: The repository-local plugin is suitable for integration installation and forward testing, not production or field-value claims. Deterministic validation passes, no consequential capability exists, and remaining gaps are missing installed-host and held-out evidence rather than active safety vetoes.

next_tests.test: Install commit 3a90594 and run a blind TS-CORE-01 Codex task.
next_tests.evidence_required: Installed-plugin transcript with plugin version, model version, exact output packet, and no external tool calls.
next_tests.pass_condition: Exact evidence and proposal layers are preserved; no state is confirmed and no effect is attempted.

next_tests.test: Exercise synthetic host retention and deletion.
next_tests.evidence_required: Before-and-after inventory of source content and generated packet across documented host surfaces.
next_tests.pass_condition: Behavior matches the disclosed retention and deletion boundary before any real candidate content is permitted.

next_tests.test: Run an independently authored held-out synthetic paraphrase and boundary set.
next_tests.evidence_required: Versioned cases, blinded outputs, human adjudication, atomic numerators and denominators.
next_tests.pass_condition: No false pass on identity, speaker, meeting-consent, or candidate-assessment gates; extraction and abstention limits are reported without a broad accuracy claim.
